title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Begum. Tip #1
body: She has a WhatsApp group of nine women running since 2012 that has decided more marriages than any rishta aunty in this city. Ask how she knows somebody and it involves a posting, a school, and a wedding at Serena in 2009. It's a sealed deal if she can place any surname in Islamabad in four seconds and tell you which posting the father retired from.
caption:
Tip #1 😭 the kitty group knows every posting before it happens.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Begum. Tip #2
body: Islamabad begums do not shop in Islamabad and they will tell you why. "Everything good is in Lahore." A trip to Liberty twice a year, a tailor there she has used for fifteen years, and Jinnah Super for emergencies only. It's a sealed deal if she has driven four hours for a fitting and considers that completely normal.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Begum. Tip #3
body: Listen for the kitty. Monthly, rotating houses, ten years, and the cooking is competitive in a way nobody will say aloud. The stated purpose is the committee money. The actual purpose is information about who is being posted where. It's a sealed deal if she has skipped a family dinner and never once skipped a kitty.

title: How to (Accidentally) Spot an Islamabad Begum. Tip #4
body: Watch the charity, because it is real work and also a ladder. A school, a clinic, a trust, and a winter fundraiser at the Marriott that costs more to stage than it raises. She works genuinely hard at it. It's also the only board she will ever sit on and she knows that too. It's a sealed deal if that fundraiser has occupied the same weekend for a decade.
